name: AnalyzerRangeDTO
description: AnalyzerRangeDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

analyzerRangeCode.description: Code used to identify the analyzer range.

dualRangeIndicator.description: Used to indicate whether the component is a dual-range analyzer.

beginDate.description: Date in which information became effective or activity started.

beginHour.description: Hour in which information became effective or activity started.

endDate.description: Last date in which information was effective or date in which activity ended. This value will be null if active record.

endHour.description: Last hour in which information was effective or hour in which activity ended. This value will be null if active record.

id.description: Unique identifier of an analyzer range history record.

componentRecordId.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring component record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.

active.description: Flag for active monitor location record
